consistency_findings.title: Ab2d+api vs Ab2d+spec exposure lists differ
consistency_findings.detail: Ab2d+api exposed methods: ['FractionOps', 'FractionOps.add', 'FractionOps.create', 'FractionOps.mul', 'FractionOps.sub', 'FractionOps.to_latex', 'IntegerOps', 'IntegerOps.fmt_num', 'IntegerOps.is_divisible', 'IntegerOps.safe_eval', 'PolynomialOps', 'PolynomialOps.div_qr', 'PolynomialOps.factor_quadratic_exact', 'PolynomialOps.format_latex', 'PolynomialOps.mul', 'RadicalOps', 'RadicalOps.format_expression', 'RadicalOps.format_term', 'RadicalOps.simplify_term']. Ab2d+spec exposed methods: ['FractionOps', 'FractionOps.add', 'FractionOps.create', 'FractionOps.from_parts', 'FractionOps.mul', 'FractionOps.sub', 'PolynomialOps', 'PolynomialOps.div_qr', 'PolynomialOps.format_latex', 'RadicalOps', 'RadicalOps.simplify_term']. Only-in-api: ['FractionOps.to_latex', 'IntegerOps', 'IntegerOps.fmt_num', 'IntegerOps.is_divisible', 'IntegerOps.safe_eval', 'PolynomialOps.factor_quadratic_exact', 'PolynomialOps.mul', 'RadicalOps.format_expression', 'RadicalOps.format_term']. Only-in-spec: ['FractionOps.from_parts'].

consistency_findings.title: Integer family is API-exposed under Ab2d+api but native-only under Ab2d+spec
consistency_findings.detail: All four Integer Math16 tasks are native-only in ab2d_spec_v2 (no Domain API). Ab2d+api exposes IntegerOps.is_divisible / safe_eval / fmt_num.

consistency_findings.title: Runtime injects all four Ops classes for every Math16 cell
consistency_findings.detail: _execute_generate_all_ops always injects IntegerOps, FractionOps, RadicalOps, PolynomialOps regardless of prompt condition or family. Prompt may say import is required; runtime does not require import. Many AVAILABLE_NOT_EXPOSED methods are therefore callable if the model invents them.

consistency_findings.title: Model redefinition of Ops is not blocked by Math16 evaluator
consistency_findings.detail: Candidate exec shares the injected namespace. A later class/assignment named IntegerOps/FractionOps/RadicalOps/PolynomialOps overwrites the injected binding. Math16 pilot02 path does not run CE115 assembly FORBIDDEN_HELPER_REDEFINED scanner.

consistency_findings.title: Negative mention of non-existent PolynomialOps.to_latex in Ab2d+spec
consistency_findings.detail: API Signature Cards explicitly state there is NO PolynomialOps.to_latex. Runtime confirms absence. Recorded as consistency note, not as inventory symbol.

consistency_findings.title: ce115_calc_exact_rational_expression_l1 operator mismatch across conditions
consistency_findings.detail: Ab2d+api exposes FractionOps.add; Ab2d+spec guardrail names FractionOps.sub; Ab2d+spec scaffold example shows FractionOps.add. Both add and sub exist at runtime.

consistency_findings.title: Ab2d+api Radical task ce113_q11 exposes FractionOps only
consistency_findings.detail: ce113_q11_rationalize_denominator is Radical family under Ab2d+api but TASK_DOMAIN_APIS lists FractionOps.create/mul/add only; RadicalOps.rationalize_linear_denominator is SUPPORTED_PUBLIC in SSOT but AVAILABLE_NOT_EXPOSED for Math16 Ab2d+api. Ab2d+spec makes this task native-only.

consistency_findings.title: Four domains do not use identical exposure style under Ab2d+spec
consistency_findings.detail: Integer: native-only. Fraction: API cards (+ create/from_parts) + guardrail methods. Polynomial: mixed (native-only q08/factor_roots; API cards / guardrails on others). Radical: mostly guardrail/class mentions without SSOT-style cards; q11 native-only.

consistency_findings.title: No same-name global function vs class method collision on Math16 Ops surface
consistency_findings.detail: Live Math16 surface uses Class.method only. Module globals get_required_domains / get_domain_helpers_code are not injected. No bare fmt_num/create global aliases observed in Math16 runner namespace.

consistency_findings.title: ab2d_spec_v2 prompt files are CRLF on this working tree
consistency_findings.detail: Byte SHA of frozen prompt files != manifest exact_prompt_sha256 due to CRLF. Canonical LF SHA matches manifest for all 16 tasks. Inventory evidence table lists file-byte SHA; dual map recorded in registry ab2d_spec_v2_prompt_hash_dual.
